incidentReports.details: Missing data after the Bitget Futures V3 recorder migration. Initial V3 sequence validation caused repeated recorder reconnects, which left low-density slices and missing ticker/derivative_ticker data for many symbols until the corrected recorder deployment restored normal collection.
